seed: Ask on a video at Next defaults: the sample recording open with History holding recordings and newer screenshots, the title bar's Ask button, 'put my latest recording after this one'. Ask looks through History, skips the screenshots, and lays the newest recording on the timeline straight after the open clip; one undo takes it back. Needs Ask's model on this Mac (docs/design/ask.md).
